name: Aizhan K.
oneLiner: Barista. I can tell you which of the forty new coffee places is actually worth your morning.
bio: I grew up two streets from Gorky Park and I pull espresso for a living, so I spend my days listening to people talk about this city. I am not a guide and I do not have a route — we just walk and I answer whatever you are curious about.

hangouts.note: Three places in one morning, all within walking distance.
The courtyards behind Panfilov, where nobody takes tourists.

usualTimes: Most evenings after 6, weekends all day

name: Dias M.
oneLiner: Engineering student who photographs the city at night. Bring a jacket, we will be out late.
bio: I have been shooting Almaty after dark for four years. I know which rooftops let you up, which bus gets you to Koktobe before the light goes, and where to eat at midnight afterwards.

hangouts.note: Sunset at Koktobe, then the Soviet mosaics lit up.
Small bars in Almaly where the crowd is local, not expat.

responseTime: usually replies in a few hours

name: Gulnara S.
oneLiner: Retired school teacher. I cook, I talk a lot, and I have lived on the same street since 1979.
bio: I taught history for thirty-one years, so you will get more context than you asked for. We can go through the Green Bazaar and I will show you what the vendors are actually selling and how to haggle without being rude.

hangouts.note: The bazaar before ten, then lunch at a canteen with no menu.
The old streets, and what used to be where.

name: Timur B.
oneLiner: I hike every weekend. Happy to take you somewhere green that is still inside the bus network.
bio: Weekday job in logistics, weekends in the Zailiysky Alatau. I am not taking anyone up a glacier — think three or four hours, a thermos, and a view most visitors never get to because they only hear about Medeu and Shymbulak.

hangouts.note: Butakovka waterfall, easy pace, back by late afternoon.
Or just a coffee if the weather turns.

name: Aruzhan T.
oneLiner: Design student. I want to practise my English and I will show you the murals nobody puts on a postcard.
bio: I am doing this mostly to talk to people from somewhere else. I know the street art in the western districts because half of it was painted by people from my faculty.

hangouts.note: You speak English with me, I answer anything about the city.
Murals in Auezov district, about two hours.

name: Yerlan A.
oneLiner: Sound engineer. If there is a gig worth going to this week, I know about it.
bio: I mix live sound at three venues in town. Come on a night when something is on and I will get you in with the regulars instead of standing at the back on your own.

hangouts.note: Whatever is playing — I will tell you if it is any good.
Late food after, the places that stay open for musicians.

usualTimes: Gig nights, usually Friday and Saturday
